events.title: The Discovery
events.text: At dawn, a fisherman finds a body at the end of Harbour Pier and calls the police.

events.title: Marcus Hale
events.text: The fisherman who discovers the body. He is nervous and keeps changing his story.

events.title: Detective Rios
events.text: The lead investigator and the victim's former partner on the force.

events.title: Casting
events.text: The role of Detective Rios was written for a much older actor and rewritten after casting.

events.title: The Interview
events.text: Rios interviews Marcus Hale at the station; Hale claims he was home all night.

events.title: Alibi
events.text: A claim or proof that a person was somewhere else when a crime took place.

events.title: Location
events.text: The pier scenes were filmed on location at a working harbour, at 5 a.m. to catch the real dawn light.

events.title: Elena Vance
events.text: The victim's sister, who arrives from out of town and demands answers.

events.title: The Sister Arrives
events.text: Elena Vance confronts Rios, accusing the department of ignoring earlier warning signs.

events.title: Red herring
events.text: A misleading clue that draws attention away from the real answer.

options.label: You can't fool me, I wasn't born yesterday.
Tum mujhe bewakoof nahi bana sakte.
A mi no me engañas, no nací ayer.

events.title: Soundtrack
events.text: The recurring cello motif is played by the composer's own daughter.

events.title: The Second Witness
events.text: A dock worker reveals he saw a small boat leave the pier before dawn.

options.label: Original: Rios walks away from the pier in silence.
Alternate: Rios lingers and looks back at the water.

events.title: Cold case
events.text: An unsolved investigation that is no longer actively pursued but is kept open.
